system.effect:
Moves with this Keyword cannot Miss when rolling with an Accuracy Roll, meaning that effects that make Moves Miss can still make Max Moves Miss, and that Max Moves may trigger Critical Hits or Effect Ranges.

If a Max Move Misses, instead of doing no damage, they deal damage as if the attack was resisted two steps further. Targets dealt damage this way still suffer any secondary effects. This means Max Moves ignores effects that would prevent the damage or effects from applying to a target.

Max Moves may be either Physical or Special.

Max Moves may not be otherwise modified or given the “Friendly” Keyword.
